text:
Victor Eklund is 20, a year and a half removed from going 16th overall, and already the rookie his coach sends out in overtime. After Wednesday's win over St. Louis, NHL.com's Stefen Rosner posted Peter DeBoer's verdict: "He's got ice in his veins." Yahoo Sports says the Calder Trophy attention is earned, and the line backs it up: 8 goals and 12 points in 24 games, with his ice time up almost two minutes a night over his last ten.

Here is the honest part. Those 8 goals came on 5.3 expected goals (our measure of the quality of his chances), and he's shooting 22% against a league norm near 13.5%. The Islanders have also scored 10.5 more goals than their chances deserve with him on the ice. That finishing rarely lasts, and the goals have already slowed to one in his last five. What's real: the trust, the minutes, and 74 hits from a 175-pound winger. Our numbers project about 44 points; watch whether his shot count climbs as the shooting cools.
headline: Victor Eklund earns the big moments; the finishing will settle
